calendarFaqs.q: Why do HCS students return after the published break ends?
calendarFaqs.a: Additional student-free days follow the four published break periods. Professional development follows Fall, Thanksgiving and Winter breaks; Spring Break is followed by Good Friday and then a professional development day. Students return October 20, December 1, January 6 and March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the HCS calendar show 180 full student days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The quarter rows total 180 days by combining 174 green student dates with six blue professional development days. Three of the green student dates are labeled as half-days, so 180 is not a count of full-length student attendance days.

calendarFaqs.q: What time do students leave on HCS half-days?
calendarFaqs.a: HCS marks December 18, March 19 and May 19 as half-days with early bus release, but the district calendar does not publish one districtwide dismissal time. Check your school's schedule for the exact pickup and transportation time.

sourceReviewSummary: We used the board-approved English HCS calendar for dates and color classifications, and the official HCS calendar page to verify the Spanish edition and current source links.
sourceReviewDetails: Reviewed the complete one-page PDF, its color legend, all month grids, half-day markings, quarter rows, midterms, report-card dates and printed totals.
Confirmed that the PDF itself prints Board Approval: 05/08/25 and that the HCS calendar page labels both English and Spanish versions approved May 8, 2025.
The board-approved PDF lists Spring Break as March 22–25 and Good Friday separately on March 26; the current HCS online event calendar displays Spring Break through March 26.
Used the blue professional development cells to determine that students return October 20, December 1, January 6 and March 30 after the four major break sequences.
Kept the printed 174, 180 and 201 totals separate because they represent different calendar accounting views.
School-specific activities, conference times, exact half-day dismissal times and later schedule changes should be confirmed through HCS or the assigned school.
